tags.throws: Will log a warning in debug mode if a key combination is invalid.

parameters.name: keyMap
parameters.description: - An object defining the key bindings and their actions.

properties.name: target
properties.description: DOM target to listen on (default: window)

properties.name: enabled
properties.description: Global toggle to disable all hooks

properties.name: debug
properties.description: If true, logs key presses to console

properties.name: sequenceTimeout
properties.description: Time in ms to wait for a sequence (e.g. "g g")

properties.name: filter
properties.description: Custom filter: return false to skip the event

returnType.name: "{ bindings: { keys: string; category: string; description: string; }[]; }"
returnType.description: Metadata about the registered bindings for UI display.

properties.name: bindings
properties.type: "{ keys: string; category: string; description: string; }[]"
